newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK VSZ POSTS LOWER 9 MONTH NET PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK VSZ POSTS LOWER 9 MONTH NET PROFIT.

text.p: Slovak steel maker VSZ a.s. said on Tuesday it posted an after-tax profit of over 940 million crowns in the first nine months of the year, compared to a 1.1 billion crown net for the same period in 1995.
VSZ added in a statement that it posted a pre-tax profit of 1.65 billion crowns for the first nine months. No comparative gross profit figures were immediately available.
"VSZ surpassed a targetted earnings result for the period before tax by 113 million crowns, or 7.3 percent, and after tax by 12 million crowns, or 1.2 percent," the statement said.
It added that the nine month net profit accounted for 71 percent and gross profit for 74 percent of the full-year target for 1996.
The statement gave no further details.
